customManagers.description: homelab/helm/**/terragrunt.hcl pins a lamp-* chart via helm_chart_name/helm_chart_version inputs, not a Chart.yaml dependency - the built-in helmv3 manager never sees it.

packageRules.description: lamp-* chart bumps here land as a merged MR triggers CI's apply:changed stage, which runs terragrunt apply against the real homelab cluster - keep merge a human decision, unlike argo-apps' automerge for the same charts.
